messages:
Mira: Heads up - our registry alert fired for rwd-base:2026-03-17 after an automated prune. scanner found an ELF with suspicious mmap+PROT_EXEC in layer sha256:beefcafe. tagging @Ade @Noah for triage.

Ade: Can you drop the scanner excerpt and manifest digest? Also any cosign info?

Mira: excerpt: 
```
scanner:v3 severity=high path=/usr/lib/ld-weird.so behavior=mmap(PROT_EXEC) execve
manifest: layers=[sha256:aaaa,sha256:bbbb,sha256:beefcafe]
cosign: signature missing for this manifest
```

Noah: Missing cosign + unexpected exec in a base image = supply-chain red flag. Ops: pause pushes to registry.redwood/rwd-base and pause prune cron.

ops: Pausing repo writes and cron `registry/prune-schedule`. Spinning a canary rollback to rwd-base:2026-03-01 (stable) at 10% traffic. Job infra/canary-4101234567 running.

Ade: Who currently has push access? We should check IAM bindings and recent IAM changes. If a temporary svc was granted, revoke it. Mira, can you attach the IAM snippet?

Mira: push principals: [svc-ci-main, deploy-bot, svc-ephemeral]. svc-ephemeral was added 3 days ago. Revoking svc-ephemeral write now. Creating incident INC-2026-0317 and linking this thread.

sec-bot: Audit entry created id=alog-4101234567 events=["registry.push:svc-ephemeral","cosign:missing","registry.prune:cron"]

Ade: KMS: query unwraps for img-signer key and any ephemeral signing keys. Look for unwraps outside CI build windows or >2 unwraps/10m. If ephemeral key unwraps are anomalous, rotate keys and revoke tokens.

Noah: Quick check: cosign certs absent, but registry metadata shows an unverified annotation from `build-system` user. That points to a CI process bypassing signing. Full KMS audit in ~10m.

Mira: Rolling back svc-ephemeral perms and creating a short rebuild plan: 1) freeze writes, 2) snapshot pinned digest of last good image, 3) rebuild minimal base (drop optional libs), 4) cosign sign with rotated prod key, 5) promote via canary. Drafting runbook now.

ops: Canary health OK at 10%. No error spike. Keeping prune paused.

Ade: Add temporary CI gate: fail pushes if cosign verify fails or signature absent. Also add alert rule for registry serving unsigned images - low threshold for 48h.

Noah: If KMS unwraps show suspicious IPs, escalate to secops and start key rotation. Also search for any unexpected service account tokens in GCS logs.

Mira: Added ticket checklist and attached scanner output + manifest digest. Will update with KMS audit result.

sec-bot: Correlation notice: linking registry events, IAM change (svc-ephemeral), and KMS query placeholder. Notifying #secops.

Ade: After rebuild+re-sign, we should push a policy change: no unconditional prune until registry integrity verified. Also require time-limited IAM conditions for any temp deployer accounts. I'll open a PR for conditioned bindings.

Noah: Good. Keep oncall looped. Mira, please post KMS unwrap audit when ready.

Mira: Will do. INC-2026-0317 updated. :white_check_mark:
